title: What Should a Navigator Remember? Spatiotemporal Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to use past observations without navigation-specific training. We study what information an 8B-scale navigation system should retain and how it should be organized for subsequent decisions. Our agent combines instruction progress, hierarchically compressed observation history anchored to poses, and accumulated geometry in complementary task, temporal, and spatial memories. An 8B observer summarizes observations, and an 8B reasoner uses the memories to select waypoint intents or request additional views, a geometric controller executes the selected targets. A semantic information perspective motivates the distinction between retaining evidence, making it accessible to the reasoner, and acquiring further observations. translated_title: 导航器应该记住什么？面向零样本视觉语言导航的时空记忆
translated_abstract: 零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在不进行导航专用训练的情况下利用过去的观测信息。我们研究了8B规模的导航系统应该保留哪些信息，以及应如何组织这些信息以支持后续决策。我们的智能体将指令进度、以位姿为锚点的分层压缩观测历史以及累积的几何信息，整合到互补的任务、时间和空间三类记忆中。一个8B的观测器负责总结观测内容，一个8B的推理器利用这些记忆来选择航点意图或请求额外视角，由几何控制器执行所选目标。一种语义信息视角促使我们区分了三件事：保留证据、使证据对推理器可访问，以及获取更多观测。在R2R-CE val-unseen数据集上，完整系统在所评估的基于Qwen3的零样本基线中取得了最高成绩。移除时间记忆会降低SR并损（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向零样本视觉语言导航的时空记忆架构，将指令进度、以位姿为锚点的分层压缩观测历史和累积几何信息组织到互补的任务、时间与空间记忆中，使8B规模的智能体无需导航专用训练即可在R2R-CE上取得领先表现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a spatiotemporal memory framework for zero-shot vision-language navigation that organizes instruction progress, pose-anchored hierarchically compressed observation history, and accumulated geometry into complementary task, temporal, and spatial memories, enabling an 8B-scale agent to achieve top zero-shot performance on R2R-CE without navigation-specific training.
